title: W-state graphs: Structure and Algorithms
summary: We study the class of edge-coloured graphs arising from the graph-theoretic representation of quantum photonic experiments that generate multipartite W-states. Abstracting away physical amplitudes and phases, we introduce W-state graphs: matching-covered graphs equipped with a half-edge 2-colouring such that every perfect matching contains exactly one bichromatic edge and every vertex is incident with a red half-edge.
